name: allertgy-workspace
description: Workspace radice per AllerTgy con avvio centralizzato

scripts.dev:mobile: cd app-mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1 || ifconfig | grep 'inet ' | grep -v 127.0.0.1 | awk '{print $2}' | head -n 1):8000 npm run start
scripts.servizio:ferma: npx pm2 delete all 2>/dev/null; bash scripts/ferma-servizio-remoto.sh
scripts.servizio:stato: npx pm2 status 2>/dev/null || cat ~/Library/Logs/AllerTgy/status.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 'Servizio non attivo'
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,WEB,MOBILE" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
